[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]75 (Hard) |event_speed = 4 |event_spawned_by = [[Snow Golem]] |event_hidden = No |event_fly = No |event_ghost = No |event_lead = No |event_immunity = {{Attr|Freeze}} }} ==Description== The '''Snowman''' is an enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It first appears on Wave 4 of [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and can be spawned by the [[Frost Mystery]] and the [[Snow Golem]]. It has higher health than the [[Frozen]] and [[Snowy]], but it is slower. Additionally, it has the [[Health Regen]], making it regenerate 2% of its health every 2 seconds. During the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], it only appeared when spawned by the [[Snow Golem]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Snowmen are often found rolling balls of snow around fields of energized ice, hoping to create a friend. Being lonely creatures, they often roll snow balls as a group until more Snowmen are created. After some time, Snowmen will fight for dominance and entangle, becoming one giant Snow Golem. For fun, they seem to enjoy throwing snow balls at Frost Ravagers before running away.''" ==Appearance== The '''Snowman''' is a white figure with two blue pebbles for eyes and has three buttons on its front center. It has a carrot for a nose and walks with its torso slightly tilted back. ==Strategy== *The '''Snowman''' is generally not a threat due its low health. **Early-game towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Cowboy]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful against it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSnowman.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SnowmanIconIG.png|'''Snowman''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Snowman''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' -
